## What changed scientifically

The producer reports that its fixed-family tangent attack found no separation and approached single-wave limits. This is a scoped unsuccessful search, not proof of equivalence, no-go or saturation of the wider problem. The printed incompatible-support value `-0.016864541969365494` comes with approximately satisfied linear constraints, but it is still a numerical support diagnostic. A pointwise/polyconvex-support incompatibility would not by itself prove a quasiconvex failure, and the searched negative value does not even provide such a positive incompatibility witness.

The sufficient pointwise SOS route remains uncertified. The initial CLARABEL call failed after an inaccurate Gram with minimum eigenvalue about `-9.8e-7`. The facially reduced current script removes two acoustic kernel directions and uses a16-by16 Gram; its later log still reports `optimal_inaccurate` with minimum eigenvalue about `-1e-7`, and the four tested cubic angles fail. None is an exact positivity certificate, an infeasibility certificate or a theorem against the route. The parent is handling these failures and continuing, so they are not evidence that the research chat stopped.

The consequential methodological change is broadening from its fixed quartic/penalty family to all15 coefficients of a homogeneous quartic on the three-dimensional space Sym(2). For a homogeneous quartic, symmetry of its fourth-order tensor exchanges the two test-matrix slots with the two rank-one direction slots. The rank-one condition can therefore be expressed as positivity of the3-by3 Hessian matrix evaluated at `(a^2,ab,b^2)` for every a,b. The proposed9-by9 PSD Gram uses the binary-quadratic monomials times the three matrix coordinates.

The classical [matrix Fejer–Riesz theorem, Theorem1.2](https://zalara.github.io/Papers/MatrixFejerRieszArxivOriginal.pdf) supports this degree-bounded univariate matrix-SOS route; homogenization and real Gram receiving still belong in its completed derivation. This is a credible enlargement of the constitutive search with a continuum condition, rather than another angular sample. The working code is not a new accepted separation or an exact rational cone certificate.

The actual test fields are scalar Hessians built from a finite Fourier family, with mean and a domain transform. That preserves differential compatibility by construction. T
